components.css: .ds-event-sidebar{background:var(--lavender,#e4d9e7);color:var(--plum,#39263c);padding:35px;}.ds-event-sidebar h2{margin:0;font:400 39px/1.12 var(--serif,"Bodoni Moda",Georgia,serif);letter-spacing:-.035em;text-wrap:balance;}.ds-event-sidebar p{margin:20px 0 0;max-width:68ch;font:400 14px/1.9 var(--sans,Manrope,Arial,sans-serif);}.ds-sidebar-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:19px;min-height:52px;padding:13px 25px;background:var(--plum,#39263c);color:var(--paper,#f5f1e9);border:1px solid var(--plum,#39263c);border-radius:0;font:500 14px/1.5 var(--sans,Manrope,Arial,sans-serif);text-align:center;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s,transform .2s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));}.ds-sidebar-button:hover{background:#5a3e58;border-color:#5a3e58;}.ds-sidebar-button:active{transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-sidebar-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--plum,#39263c);outline-offset:5px;}.ds-sidebar-button svg{flex-shrink:0;transition:transform .25s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));}.ds-sidebar-button:hover svg{transform:translate(2px,-2px);}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-sidebar-button,.ds-sidebar-button svg{transition:none;}}.ds-sidebar-button{margin-top:25px;gap:12px;padding-inline:18px;font-size:13px;max-width:100%;}@media(max-width:980px){.ds-event-sidebar{padding:25px;}.ds-event-sidebar h2{font-size:33px;}}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-event-sidebar{padding:28px;}.ds-event-sidebar h2{font-size:35px;}.ds-event-sidebar p{font-size:13px;}.ds-sidebar-button{font-size:12px;}}

narrative.overview:
A personal invitation into Dóra’s practice: warm paper, rich plum typography, quiet lavender fields, and actual photographs of the teacher, her community, and their surroundings. The user selected the direction with “Build the first preview — ivory and plum.”

The atmosphere is open, warm, and composed. Large serif headings, restrained italic emphasis, generous space, and crisp photography establish the character. Manrope makes supporting information and the path to booking easy to read. The recurring photograph overlaps and flat color fields give the site depth without surrounding every story in a card.
keyCharacteristics: Original business photography with deliberate crops and useful alternative text.
High-contrast serif headings paired with clear sans-serif information.
Warm ivory, plum, and lavender in broad, flat fields.
Rectangular controls, fine rules, and restrained interaction.

rules.name: The Inverse Focus Rule
rules.body: Keep the lavender focus outline on plum fields; the default plum outline belongs on light surfaces.

rules.name: The Flat Story Rule
rules.body: Use whitespace, imagery, and rules to separate stories; reserve a filled container for an existing functional pattern such as an enquiry panel or event sidebar.

dos: **Do** use Dóra’s sourced photography, useful alt text, and intentional crops.
**Do** pair Bodoni Moda headings with Manrope information and controls.
**Do** preserve generous gutters, readable text widths, and the single-column mobile sequence.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus, the light outline on dark fields, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: **Don't** replace the selected ivory and plum direction with a new palette or type pairing.
**Don't** turn flat stories into rounded, shadowed cards.
**Don't** hide essential content behind decorative animation or use stock imagery in place of the business photographs.
**Don't** imply that an enquiry was sent when the interface has only prepared an email draft.
